item.title: Nixa man allegedly grabs police officer's rifle during arrest
item.description: Gary Dean Hord, 63, was arrested for first-degree harassment, resisting arrest, and attempting to disarm a peace officer while performing official duty after threatening to kill a victim and refusing to comply with commands, and refusing to let go of an officer's patrol rifle.

item.title: Feel Old Yet? These 10 country songs are turning 20 years old in 2026
item.description: 10 country songs from 2006, including "Jesus, Take the Wheel" by Carrie Underwood and "Summertime" by Kenny Chesney, are turning 20 years old this year.

item.title: Homicide: Shooting in Springfield leaves one dead, suspect arrested

item.title: Christian County reveals procession route for fallen deputies
item.description: A law enforcement procession will be held on Saturday for fallen deputies Gabriel Ramirez and Michael Hislope, starting at James River Church in Ozark and traveling to Greenlawn Funeral Home, with the public invited to pay their respects along the route.

item.title: Thousands expected for funeral procession Saturday
item.description: Hundreds of people are paying their respects at the memorial for Christian County Deputies Gabriel Ramirez and Michael Hislope, with thousands expected to attend the public visitation and procession.
